press_references.value: KFSHRC and Kopra Bio sign MoU to accelerate viral-vector oncology

partnership_announcements.description: Kopra Bio and King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Centre signed an MoU to explore a strategic collaboration advancing viral-vector oncology, starting with KB-516. The framework covers IND-enabling studies, clinical-grade vector manufacturing, U.S. FDA and Saudi FDA submissions, and a Phase 1/2a glioblastoma trial in Saudi Arabia, with a potential value-based model including KFSHRC in-kind support for equity.
